thesis: PGNY is a clean post-earnings trend continuation. It is profitable and cash generative, with accelerating YoY growth. It has held its gap-up for about three weeks in a tight base below the 52-week high. The technical card gives a defined dip-entry (35.5-36.3) with a stop just under the swing low and a measured-move target. The setup risk is small relative to the reward. The case is only moderate. The stock is extended, the regime is risk-off, and the session is a thin half day, so this is a dip-buy at the planned zone, not a chase. Size should be modest.
